versions.changelog: Initial publish: Codex CLI agent skill for non-interactive coding tasks

codex-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release providing a managed agent for Codex CLI automation.
- Supports non-interactive (exec) and interactive (tmux) execution modes.
- Enables full workspace write, safe auto-approval, and optional high-effort reasoning.
- Workflow includes worktree isolation, task tracking, and adaptive timeout handling.
- Designed for hands-off, end-to-end coding task automation without user prompts.
